Principal Data Center & Cloud Engineering Lead and Strategist - Remote (Atlanta, GA)

The Principal Data Center & Cloud Engineering Lead and Strategist will own assigned engineering strategy and technical assurance activities, connecting physical infrastructure conditions with enterprise architecture, modernization priorities, and long-term investment decisions. The role requires a hands-on approach to site assessments, architecture development, automation, and operational readiness, alongside the ability to communicate complex technical and financial considerations to senior leadership.

  • Develop long-term infrastructure strategy: Lead the creation and continuous refinement of a ten-year data center and hybrid-cloud strategy covering site roles, capacity, resilience, AI infrastructure demand, lifecycle risks, consolidation, cloud placement, and retirement.

  • Translate strategic direction into rolling three-year modernization roadmaps, annual priorities, investment options, and executable engineering work packages.

  • Compare infrastructure alternatives using documented assumptions, cost and risk scenarios, investment dependencies, and mission requirements.

  • Conduct physical data center assessments: Personally perform onsite walkthroughs and validate rack elevations, equipment, power connections, cabling, labels, network paths, environmental readings, and asset records.

  • Evaluate rack density, redundant A/B power paths, power distribution units, airflow, cooling capacity, hot/cold aisle containment, physical clearances, and maintenance access.

  • Distinguish installed capacity from usable capacity under normal operating, failure, and maintenance conditions, coordinating electrical and mechanical validation with qualified specialists.

  • Design hybrid-cloud architectures: Develop integrated compute, storage, networking, virtualization, container, backup, and recovery architectures across physical data centers and cloud environments.

  • Assess workload placement and determine whether systems should remain in place, consolidate, refresh, migrate, modernize, or retire.

  • Coordinate with application and mainframe owners to understand dependencies and develop reference architectures, placement recommendations, and migration plans.

  • Plan AI-ready infrastructure: Evaluate the infrastructure requirements of AI training, fine-tuning, and inference workloads, including GPU and accelerator capacity, memory, rack density, power, cooling, networking, storage throughput, data locality, and resilience.

  • Assess air- and liquid-cooling options, facility readiness, utilization, and cloud-versus-on-premises economics to develop realistic, phased AI infrastructure recommendations.

  • Lead infrastructure automation: Define an automation roadmap covering bare-metal, virtual, and cloud provisioning, configuration and firmware lifecycle management, patching, network and storage integration, tagging, inventory reconciliation, backup onboarding, and decommissioning.

  • Develop and review reusable infrastructure-as-code modules, scripts, and orchestration workflows using Git-based version control, automated testing, policy checks, controlled credentials, and rollback mechanisms.

  • Integrate deployment workflows with ITSM, monitoring, and configuration records to ensure traceability and operational supportability.

  • Evaluate AI-assisted operations: Collaborate with data, AI, and operations specialists to assess use cases such as anomaly detection, capacity forecasting, predictive maintenance, incident correlation, and assisted diagnostics.

  • Define data-quality requirements, performance baselines, evaluation criteria, human oversight, and measurable benefits while maintaining security, approval, and recovery controls.

  • Ensure engineering quality and operational readiness: Lead technical assessments, design reviews, and implementation validation, including airflow and thermal studies, computational fluid dynamics where required, and integration testing.

  • Establish capacity, performance, failover, recovery, and acceptance criteria, ensuring cutover plans, rollback procedures, maintenance windows, operating procedures, and support ownership are documented before release.

  • Maintain engineering records and financial evidence: Keep rack layouts, technical drawings, cable and power schedules, dependency maps, lifecycle records, and DCIM/CMDB relationships accurate and current.

  • Apply the READI approach—Reliability, Evidence, Asset Lifecycle, Design Risk, and Infrastructure Capacity—to connect engineering findings with investment and modernization decisions.

  • Collaborate with FinOps and business teams to evaluate total cost, cost of inaction, utilization, capacity release, and validated benefits.

  • Provide technical leadership: Lead and mentor multidisciplinary engineers, facilitate design reviews, and promote reusable engineering patterns through an Automation and Engineering Center of Excellence.

  • Coordinate with application hosting, application services, cloud, data center operations, infrastructure providers, security, and facilities teams.

  • Present architecture alternatives, costs, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior leaders while maintaining hands-on technical credibility with delivery teams.

  • Produce key deliverables, including long-term infrastructure strategies, modernization roadmaps, site assessment reports, AI-readiness assessments, reference architectures, tested automation workflows, migration and rollback plans, technical validation reports, and operational documentation.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate will bring extensive infrastructure engineering experience, combining deep physical data center expertise with enterprise cloud architecture and modernization leadership. They should have a proven track record of translating long-term infrastructure strategies into implemented technical improvements, with strong hands-on capabilities in automation, capacity planning, and engineering validation. Excellent technical communication and the ability to engage with both engineering specialists and executive stakeholders are essential.

  • At least 15 years of progressively responsible infrastructure engineering experience, including:

  • 8+ years in data center engineering or architecture.

  • 5+ years leading complex engineering or infrastructure modernization initiatives.

  • These experience periods may overlap.

  • Demonstrated responsibility across both physical infrastructure and hybrid-cloud environments.

  • Recent, hands-on experience conducting data center assessments, with practical expertise in:

  • Rack elevations, equipment placement, and physical infrastructure validation.

  • Power-path redundancy, power distribution units, and electrical capacity.

  • Airflow, cooling systems, and environmental constraints.

  • Cabling, connectivity, rack density, and infrastructure capacity.

  • As-built documentation and asset reconciliation.

  • Ability to interpret and critically review electrical single-line diagrams, mechanical documentation, network designs, and rack layouts in collaboration with qualified specialists.

  • Proven experience developing multi-year data center or infrastructure strategies and translating them into successfully implemented modernization initiatives.

  • Direct technical leadership of infrastructure consolidation, migration, refresh, resilience improvement, or decommissioning projects, with demonstrable individual contributions and results.

  • Substantial experience with at least one major cloud platform and enterprise compute, storage, networking, virtualization, and backup/recovery technologies.

  • Ability to evaluate workload placement, hybrid connectivity, resilience, capacity, and infrastructure lifecycle trade-offs.

  • Hands-on experience developing or reviewing infrastructure automation, APIs, source-controlled configurations, testing processes, and recovery logic.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Ansible, Terraform, Python, and PowerShell, or comparable technologies. Expertise in every listed tool is not required.

  • Ability to assess AI infrastructure requirements and evaluate AI-enabled operational improvements safely and realistically.

  • Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams, mentoring technical staff, and facilitating architecture reviews.

  • Ability to conduct onsite data center assessments and travel to designated facilities while complying with applicable safety and access procedures.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain the personnel suitability, credentials, system access, and training required for a Tier 4 / High Risk clearance.

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or an allowable equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Excellent technical writing and communication skills, including the ability to defend architecture decisions with engineers and explain investment recommendations to executive leadership.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs, another federal agency, or a large regulated enterprise.

  • Experience planning or deploying AI/HPC infrastructure or GPU-based platforms.

  • Familiarity with high-density data center environments and liquid-cooled infrastructure.

  • Experience with thermal analysis, computational fluid dynamics (CFD), or digital-twin validation.

  • Experience integrating ITSM and DCIM platforms.

  • Background establishing or leading an engineering or automation Center of Excellence.

  • Relevant certifications in data center design, cloud architecture, automation, or infrastructure engineering.

You will own the proactive technical direction of multiple managed services accounts, ensuring that each client's network architecture evolves according to industry best practices, security requirements, and business priorities. Working closely with operations, service delivery, and account teams, you will translate technical findings into actionable recommendations, guide implementation, and provide expert support when complex challenges arise.

  • Architectural direction and client advisory

  • Serve as the designated Proactive Engineer for a portfolio of managed services clients, defining their technical direction and long-term improvement priorities.

  • Conduct comprehensive architectural reviews covering network topology, segmentation, redundancy, high availability, routing, WAN design, firewall and security architecture, zero-trust solutions, application delivery, wireless, and voice.

  • Analyze health checks, configuration reviews, monitoring trends, service reports, and incident histories to identify risks and underlying causes of instability.

  • Develop and maintain prioritized client roadmaps, ranking recommendations according to risk, business impact, effort, and cost.

  • Distinguish between improvements covered by existing managed services agreements and work requiring separate professional services engagements.

  • Present recommendations to client IT leaders alongside service delivery and account stakeholders, securing agreement on priorities and timelines.

  • Track progress through client service reports and executive business reviews.

  • Advise on technology lifecycles, including end-of-sale and end-of-life exposure, software releases, licensing changes, subscriptions, and infrastructure refresh planning.

  • Technical standards and operational guidance

  • Establish client-specific configuration baselines, hardening standards, target software releases, and architectural guidelines for operations teams.

  • Review upgrade plans, policy cleanups, and remediation activities to ensure alignment with approved client roadmaps.

  • Evaluate implementation and rollback plans for high-risk changes.

  • Contribute to reference architectures, best-practice checklists, and consistent technical review methods.

  • Mentor Level 1 to Level 3 engineers and lead knowledge-sharing sessions on new technologies, vendor developments, and lessons learned from escalations.

  • Vendor and technology management

  • Monitor vendor roadmaps, software releases, security advisories, end-of-life milestones, and licensing changes across supported technologies.

  • Translate emerging developments, including SD-WAN, SASE, and platform migrations, into proactive client recommendations.

  • Maintain relationships with vendor technical teams to gain early insight into product changes and escalate recurring or systemic issues.

  • Implementation and technical delivery

  • Collaborate with the Converged Network practice and operations teams to advance approved client recommendations.

  • Produce high-level and low-level designs, implementation sequences, and acceptance criteria for remediation and improvement projects.

  • Provide hands-on technical support for complex or high-risk implementations requiring architectural expertise.

  • Validate completed work against the approved design and ensure successful outcomes.

  • Transfer completed improvements to operations teams with updated diagrams, runbooks, and documentation.

  • Level 4 escalation and problem management

  • Act as the highest technical escalation point for complex managed services issues, supporting engineers and coordinating with vendors and carriers when necessary.

  • Participate in high-priority incidents and high-profile client engagements, providing technical leadership, clear communication, and responsive support.

  • Lead in-depth root-cause analysis for major and recurring incidents.

• Product Strategy & Ownership

  • Define and execute the long-term product vision and strategy, including target audience, market positioning, core gameplay pillars, and a one-to-three-year development roadmap.

  • Own the product's business performance, including revenue growth, profitability, long-term value, and investment efficiency.

  • Balance short-term commercial priorities with long-term product investments and allocate resources accordingly.

  • Make strategic decisions regarding the launch, scaling, iteration, or discontinuation of product features and initiatives.

  • Drive improvements in retention, engagement, payer conversion, average revenue per paying user (ARPPU), monetization, lifetime value (LTV), and other key performance indicators.

  • Global Launch & Product Scaling

  • Lead global launch preparation and execution, defining target KPIs, launch-readiness criteria, go/no-go decisions, and post-launch scaling plans.

  • Coordinate launch activities with marketing and development teams, ensuring alignment on priorities and timelines.

  • Partner with marketing leadership on user acquisition, re-engagement economics, and scaling decisions, taking into account the longer payback periods associated with midcore audiences.

  • Ensure high-quality, timely delivery of product updates in collaboration with development leadership and producers.

  • Identify and mitigate product and technical risks, particularly around server-side and social features.

  • Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Build, hire, and develop a strong product team with deep midcore expertise, including meta and combat design, competitive economies, and narrative development.

  • Develop an autonomous, scalable team and support the growth of product leaders and key specialists.

  • Align Product, Game Design, Narrative, Art, Development, Analytics, Marketing, and Finance around shared objectives and priorities.

  • Establish transparent cross-functional decision-making processes and contribute to broader product strategy and long-term organizational development.

  • Market Research & Growth Opportunities

  • Continuously monitor the midcore gaming market, audience behavior, competitors, successful mechanics, LiveOps practices, monetization models, genre trends, and user acquisition costs.

  • Identify proven market solutions and adapt relevant opportunities to the product through structured hypotheses and experiments.

  • Develop and evaluate intellectual property (IP) collaborations, including partner selection, business cases, content integration, and impact measurement across acquisition, retention, and revenue.

  • Explore additional growth opportunities through new markets, localization, platforms, partnerships, cross-promotion, game modes, and content formats.

  • Prioritize opportunities using data, market benchmarks, and clearly defined success criteria.

  • Prepare business cases for major initiatives and partnerships, outlining expected impact, resources, timelines, and risks.

  • Systematically evaluate experiments and post-release performance, scaling successful practices and discontinuing ineffective approaches.

  • AI-Driven Production & Operational Excellence

  • Promote an AI-first approach to content production by introducing tools that optimize the creation of locations, characters, artwork, text, and localization.

  • Improve production speed and cost efficiency without compromising creative quality.

  • Establish a predictable content and LiveOps cadence with sustainable production economics.

  • Strengthen product processes and contribute to greater maturity and effectiveness across the wider product function.

    • Requirements:

  • Significant senior product leadership experience in the gaming industry as a Product Director, Head of Product, Executive Producer, or in a comparable role.

  • Strong experience with live mobile free-to-play (F2P) midcore games, such as RPGs, strategy games, 4X titles, or battlers.

  • Proven track record leading soft launches, global launches, and subsequent product scaling.

  • Demonstrated ability to define and implement product strategy and take ownership of business performance, investment decisions, and resource allocation.

  • Strong analytical and commercial capabilities, including experience developing business cases and making data-informed product and investment decisions.

  • Deep understanding of midcore gameplay systems, including meta progression, hero and collection systems, game economies, social and competitive features such as guilds, alliances and PvP, LiveOps, and F2P monetization.

Lead end-to-end revenue cycle operations, ensuring accurate billing, efficient reimbursement, regulatory compliance, and strong financial performance.   • Payer Contracts and Reimbursement: Review and analyze payer contracts, reimbursement methodologies, fee schedules, timely filing requirements, authorization rules, payment policies, and contract amendments.

  • Support payer contracting activities through financial modeling, reimbursement analysis, rate proposals, and negotiation preparation.

  • Audit benefit verifications, authorization processes, monthly performance reports, and collections while ensuring the billing partner meets agreed service levels.

  • Drive improvements in first-pass payment rates, denial management, days in accounts receivable (A/R), underpayment recovery, and net collections.

  • Multi-State Expansion and Compliance: Lead payer and reimbursement readiness for new-state expansion and acquired practices, including state-specific payer requirements and Medicaid regulations.

  • Oversee provider credentialing and enrollment to ensure clinicians are authorized and ready to bill from their start dates.

  • Lead billing and coding audits while ensuring compliance with HIPAA, CMS, Medicaid, commercial payer requirements, and applicable state regulations.

  • Partner with clinical leadership to improve documentation quality, PT/OT coding accuracy, modifier usage, and timed-unit billing.

• Conduct on-site and remote monitoring activities throughout the clinical trial lifecycle, including site initiation, routine monitoring, and close-out visits.

  • Perform unmasked Clinical Research Associate activities for assigned ophthalmology studies, ensuring appropriate investigational product accountability and oversight of unblinded site activities.

  • Geographic Atrophy (GA).

You will take responsibility for delivering end-to-end logistics and supply chain projects, ensuring that proposed solutions meet operational, financial, and strategic objectives.   • Manage client relationships and coordinate stakeholders at both operational and executive levels.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of consulting services, methodologies, and quality standards by sharing your expertise and proposing new solutions.

    • Requirements:

    You bring substantial experience in logistics consulting, logistics planning, intralogistics, or supply chain management, along with a proven ability to lead complex projects independently. You combine strong analytical and conceptual skills with commercial awareness, a practical understanding of operational processes, and the confidence to advise clients and engage senior stakeholders. You are proactive, structured, and solution-oriented, with a strong sense of responsibility and a commitment to delivering high-quality results.

  • A university degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field.

  • Several years of relevant professional experience in logistics consulting, logistics planning, intralogistics, or supply chain management.

  • Proven experience independently managing and successfully delivering complex logistics or supply chain projects, ideally within a consulting firm or a demanding industrial or logistics environment.

  • In-depth expertise in at least one key area, such as logistics planning, process optimization, automation, logistics IT, or supply chain management.

  • Strong analytical and conceptual abilities, with a solid understanding of commercial and operational relationships.

  • Excellent consulting, communication, and presentation skills, with confidence in working with clients, project partners, and senior decision-makers.

  • An independent, structured, and solution-driven approach, supported by entrepreneurial thinking and high quality standards.

  • Strong decision-making skills, accountability, and the ability to drive complex projects forward effectively.

  • Very good German and good English language skills.

• Design, build, and maintain Google Cloud infrastructure using Terraform, ensuring production infrastructure is defined as code and changes are reviewed through pull requests.

  • Operate and continuously improve Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) clusters, including upgrades, capacity planning, autoscaling, networking, and workload isolation.

  • Migrate manually deployed services to Kubernetes, establishing documented, consistent, and repeatable deployment processes.

  • Consolidate configuration, access, and user management across Google Cloud projects into a centralized source of truth.

  • Maintain clearly separated and secure environments for internal services, partner workloads, and future community-facing services.

  • Collaborate with internal engineering teams to migrate their infrastructure to Infrastructure as Code and Kubernetes-based environments.

  • Maintain and improve GitHub Actions workflows, applying security best practices such as pinned dependencies, least-privilege tokens, efficient runner usage, and cost controls.

  • Develop and maintain observability capabilities across metrics, logging, and alerting to ensure services are monitored and actionable issues are identified promptly.

  • Apply least-privilege access controls across Google Cloud, Kubernetes, and GitHub, regularly reviewing temporary administrative permissions.

  • Contribute to quarterly and annual technical roadmaps, provide realistic project estimates, and recommend discovery phases for complex initiatives.

  • Take ownership of infrastructure services from design through operation, ensuring reliability, security, scalability, and maintainability.

    • Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • At least 5 years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), platform engineering, or infrastructure engineering, including at least 2 years operating production workloads at a senior level.

  • Strong hands-on experience managing Kubernetes in production, including deployments, networking, upgrades, autoscaling, and troubleshooting.

  • Advanced experience with Terraform, including module design, state management, and infrastructure management across multiple environments.

  • Solid practical knowledge of Google Cloud Platform, particularly GKE, IAM, networking, Pub/Sub, and similar managed services.

  • Experience implementing and operating observability solutions for metrics, logs, and alerting using Grafana or comparable tools.

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitHub Actions, as well as developing and operating containerized services using Docker.

  • Strong understanding of infrastructure security practices, including secrets management, identity and access management (IAM), and least-privilege principles.

  • Solid Linux and networking fundamentals, with scripting skills in Bash.

  • Proven experience migrating manually managed services to Infrastructure as Code.

  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote and asynchronous environment, manage priorities effectively, and communicate clearly with stakeholders.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

    • Nice to have:

  • Google Cloud certifications, such as Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect, or Kubernetes certifications such as CKA or CKS.

  • Experience operating infrastructure in environments with strict security requirements.

  • Experience managing large-scale push notification infrastructure, including Firebase Cloud Messaging or Apple Push Notification service (APNs).

  • Familiarity with peer-to-peer technologies or distributed systems.

  • Knowledge of Node.js services and their production deployment and operation.

  • Fully remote working arrangement, with the opportunity to work from anywhere worldwide.

  • Opportunity to join a globally distributed team of experienced technology professionals.

  • Hands-on ownership of critical infrastructure and the opportunity to influence technical architecture and engineering standards.

  • Opportunity to work with modern cloud technologies, including Google Cloud, Kubernetes, Terraform, and automation tooling.

  • Collaborative environment that encourages independent decision-making, technical innovation, and continuous improvement.

  • Exposure to large-scale digital infrastructure and services in the evolving fintech and technology sectors.

Senior Director, Investor Relations and Market Intelligence

The Senior Director will own the investor relations program and market intelligence function, ensuring that external communications accurately reflect the organization's performance, strategy, and valuation. Working closely with the CFO and executive leadership, this individual will strengthen investor confidence, broaden the shareholder base, and translate market feedback into actionable business insights.

  • Lead the quarterly earnings process: Coordinate and oversee all preparation activities, including earnings releases, executive scripts, earnings call presentations, live Q&A preparation, and post-call follow-up.

  • Shape the corporate equity story: Challenge and refine external messaging to deliver a clear, consistent, and compelling narrative connecting operating performance, financial results, guidance, valuation, and investor perceptions.

  • Develop investor relations strategy: Establish and execute communications and outreach plans focused on attracting new institutional investors and broadening and diversifying the shareholder base.

  • Manage investor targeting and engagement: Identify and cultivate prospective investors, organize non-deal roadshows, investor conferences, and other external events, and coordinate participation and content with senior management.

  • Represent the organization externally: Serve as a primary contact for institutional investors, sell-side analysts, and other market participants through meetings, calls, and events, progressively taking on independent representation of the business.

  • Lead market intelligence activities: Manage sell-side consensus estimates, analyze investor expectations, valuation, earnings sensitivities, and financial models, and monitor competitors, sector developments, and shareholder trends.

  • Provide strategic market insights: Consolidate feedback from shareholders and analysts and deliver quarterly insights to executive management and the Board to inform business strategy, performance discussions, and external messaging.

  • Drive leadership alignment: Influence organizational priorities and ensure that business performance narratives and external communications remain consistent with the investor relations strategy.

  • Strengthen executive capital-markets capabilities: Partner with the CFO to improve leadership teams' investor readiness, financial-market understanding, and external communication skills.

  • Build strong stakeholder relationships: Deliver responsive, proactive, and high-quality engagement with institutional investors, analysts, and internal and external stakeholders.

  • Ensure regulatory compliance: Maintain compliance with Regulation Fair Disclosure and applicable securities regulations, handling confidential and material non-public information with appropriate discretion.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in public-company finance, investor relations, or closely related capital-markets roles, with the credibility to engage independently with investors and senior executives. Strong financial analysis, strategic communication, and executive influence are essential, alongside the ability to translate complex financial and operational information into a clear investment narrative.

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Accounting, Economics, or Business Administration; an MBA is preferred.

  • At least 7 years of progressive experience in finance and capital markets, including 3 or more years in public-company investor relations or a closely related field such as equity research, investment banking, or strategic finance.

  • At least 4 years of finance or capital-markets exposure.

  • Demonstrated experience managing earnings processes and communicating with senior executives and external investment stakeholders.

  • Strong understanding of capital markets, including the ability to interpret consensus estimates, valuation metrics, earnings sensitivities, and investor financial models.

  • Ability to independently manage discussions with institutional investors and sell-side analysts.

  • Experience developing investor-facing materials, including presentations, due diligence questionnaires (DDQs), requests for proposals (RFPs), and newsletters.

  • Proven ability to influence change, build consensus, and align leadership teams around strategic priorities and external messaging.

  • Previous experience in a public-company environment is required.

  • Background in financial planning and analysis (FP&A) or financial controllership is strongly preferred.

  • Previous experience as a Director or senior investor relations leader with ownership of quarterly earnings processes is highly desirable.

  • CFA designation or an equivalent professional credential is an asset.

  • Experience in industrials, transportation, marketplaces, or business services is advantageous.

  • Exceptional written, verbal, analytical, and interpersonal communication skills, with strong executive presence and sound capital-markets judgment.

    • Benefits:

  • Annual base salary: $250,000–$300,000.

  • Short-term and long-term incentives: Competitive incentive opportunities representing a significant component of total compensation.

  • Healthcare coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Life insurance: Basic life insurance coverage.

  • Retirement savings: Access to a 401(k) plan with a 100% employer match on the first 4% of employee contributions.

  • Paid time off: 15 days of PTO annually.

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid arrangement for candidates based in the Chicago area, with fully remote opportunities available for exceptional candidates elsewhere in the United States.

  • Employment type: Full-time position.

  • Lead the end-to-end development of complex software solutions and large-scale initiatives spanning multiple systems and engineering teams.

  • Take ownership of project execution, from technical design and implementation through deployment and rollout, ensuring alignment with business objectives.

  • Design, architect, and develop robust backend services using Python, Flask, and/or FastAPI.

  • Leverage AI-assisted coding tools, autonomous development workflows, and agentic technologies to improve engineering productivity and delivery.

  • Provide technical guidance through code reviews, architectural discussions, engineering best practices, and effective collaboration with AI coding agents.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers, helping them strengthen their technical capabilities, problem-solving approaches, and software design skills.

  • Contribute to strategic engineering planning and influence technical roadmaps, including the adoption of agentic software development lifecycle practices.

  • Independently investigate and resolve complex technical challenges using advanced debugging techniques and AI-assisted development tools.

  • Drive architectural improvements and influence project- and team-level technical decisions to support long-term system evolution.

  • Improve system reliability, scalability, observability, and performance while strengthening incident response practices.

  • Establish engineering standards, documentation, tooling, and development processes that improve code quality and operational efficiency.

  • Promote automated code reviews, refactoring agents, and quality guardrails across engineering workflows.

  • Break down complex initiatives into clear milestones and actionable tasks that enable effective collaboration and execution.

  • Communicate technical concepts and recommendations clearly to engineers, product managers, and senior leadership.

  • Navigate ambiguity and evolving requirements while providing structure, direction, and technical leadership to engineering teams.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate brings extensive experience building complex software systems, strong backend engineering expertise, and the ability to influence technical decisions across teams. You should combine excellent problem-solving and communication skills with a proactive approach to engineering quality, collaboration, and emerging AI-powered development practices.

  • 7+ years of professional experience delivering complex software systems and resolving challenging engineering problems.

  • Strong backend engineering experience designing, architecting, and developing reliable services using Python, Flask, and/or FastAPI.

  • Experience writing comprehensive backend tests, particularly with Pytest, and maintaining strong test coverage.

  • Familiarity with frontend development frameworks such as React, Next.js, and TypeScript is a plus.

  • Experience building consumer-facing applications and internal software tools.

  • Ability to break down complex technical initiatives into manageable components, milestones, and deliverables for other engineers.

  • Strong understanding of software architecture, engineering best practices, system reliability, scalability, and performance optimization.

  • Experience using or adopting AI-assisted coding tools, autonomous development workflows, or agentic engineering practices is valuable.

  • Demonstrated ability to improve engineering standards, development processes, and the overall quality of software delivery.

  • Proven experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and coordinating initiatives involving multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong technical leadership, mentoring, and code review capabilities.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, and take ownership of high-impact initiatives.

  • Motivation to continuously improve engineering practices and contribute to the long-term technical direction of an organization.

  • Must be legally authorized to work in Canada at the time of hire without requiring current or future employer-sponsored work visa support.

  • Candidates based in Vancouver, British Columbia, who can work in a hybrid capacity, are strongly preferred; remote candidates elsewhere in Canada are also welcome.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive base salary ranging from CAD $145,000 to $160,000, depending on experience and geographic location.

  • Eligibility to participate in company bonus and equity programs, subject to applicable plans, eligibility requirements, and approvals.

You will take ownership of full-stack development and modernization initiatives while providing technical direction and supporting the delivery of reliable enterprise applications. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Maintain, troubleshoot, and modernize enterprise ASP.NET web applications across frontend components, API layers, and databases.

  • Design, develop, test, and implement new application features, modules, and technical improvements.

  • Modernize legacy .NET applications, including migration initiatives toward Blazor and improvements to application performance.

  • Build, integrate, and maintain REST APIs and WSDL/SOAP services to support enterprise application requirements.

  • Optimize SQL Server databases through query tuning, stored procedures, views, indexing strategies, and performance analysis.

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership, including architectural guidance, code reviews, and technical problem-solving.

  • Mentor and support engineering team members, encouraging knowledge sharing and strong development practices.

  • Facilitate daily product standups to monitor progress, identify technical blockers, and maintain delivery momentum.

  • Collaborate with product and cross-functional teams to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.

  • Contribute to Agile/Scrum ceremonies and support continuous improvement throughout the software development lifecycle.

  • Explore AI-assisted development tools and modern engineering practices to improve productivity and delivery quality.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate will have strong full-stack software engineering experience, a solid background in the .NET ecosystem, and the ability to combine technical execution with team leadership. They should be comfortable working autonomously, solving complex problems, and collaborating in distributed Agile teams.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field.

  • At least 6 years of recent full-stack software engineering experience.

  • Strong backend development skills with ASP.NET, .NET Core, and C#.

  • Experience with frontend technologies such as HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, AJAX, and jQuery.

  • Familiarity with modern UI frameworks and components, including Blazor Components, Telerik, Kendo UI, and Bootstrap.

  • Proven experience modernizing legacy .NET applications, including migration to Blazor and enterprise web performance optimization.

  • Strong knowledge of REST APIs and WSDL/SOAP services, with experience using tools such as Postman, Swagger/Swashbuckle, Fiddler, and SoapUI.

  • Advanced SQL Server skills, including stored procedures, views, indexing strategies, SQL Server Profiler, and execution plans.

  • Experience using Visual Studio 2022 or later, Git, and TFS.

  • Previous experience acting as a hands-on technical lead and mentoring engineers within Agile Scrum teams.

  • Strong understanding of software development best practices, application security, and performance optimization.

  • Advanced English proficiency, both written and spoken.

  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities across the full technology stack.

  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with a collaborative and hands-on approach.

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or ChatGPT.

  • Advanced knowledge of UI/UX optimization techniques for data-intensive enterprise applications.

  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms, particularly Microsoft Azure.

  • Access to ongoing learning opportunities, including education, technical training, and English classes.

  • Inclusive and diverse working environment focused on employee development, collaboration, and belonging.

As a Senior Global Benefits Specialist, you will own the global benefits portfolio and contribute to the development of a scalable Total Rewards strategy. You will combine strategic planning with hands-on execution, improving processes, managing external relationships, and ensuring a consistent employee experience across countries.

  • Define and implement the global benefits strategy in partnership with the Head of Total Rewards, ensuring programs support talent attraction, retention, and business objectives.

  • Manage the global portfolio of health, retirement, risk, and wellbeing benefits across company entities and Employer of Record (EOR) arrangements.

  • Oversee annual benefits renewals, benchmarking, plan design, and open enrollment cycles across relevant markets.

  • Manage day-to-day benefits administration, including employee enrollments, terminations, qualifying life events, payroll and HRIS integrations, and EOR coordination.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for employee benefits inquiries, providing clear guidance and resolving issues efficiently.

  • Develop benefits documentation, employee guides, open enrollment communications, and manager resources to improve awareness and understanding of available programs.

  • Evaluate, implement, and optimize benefits technology, including ownership and administration of benefits functionality within Rippling HRIS.

  • Manage relationships with external brokers, insurance carriers, and benefits providers, including vendor assessments, contract discussions, and requests for proposals.

  • Monitor and maintain compliance with applicable benefits regulations across all operating countries, including US requirements such as ERISA, ACA, COBRA, and nondiscrimination testing.

  • Manage the global benefits budget and forecasts in collaboration with Finance, using data to support planning and decision-making.

  • Lead benefits implementation for new market entries, transitions from EOR arrangements to owned entities, and mergers and acquisitions.

  • Partner with HR Operations and Payroll teams on leave of absence administration and related benefits processes.

  • Audit existing programs, identify operational gaps, establish clear ownership and responsibilities, and build new processes that support international growth.

  • Drive continuous improvement by assessing how technology, external providers, and internal workflows can make benefits delivery more efficient and employee-focused.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate brings extensive experience managing global benefits programs, particularly across North America and international markets. You should combine strong technical knowledge of benefits administration and compliance with analytical capabilities, sound judgment, and the ability to independently lead cross-functional initiatives in a dynamic environment.

  • At least 6 years of experience managing global employee benefits programs, ideally within a high-growth technology company.

  • Proven experience building, transforming, and scaling benefits programs across multiple countries and employing entities.

  • Strong expertise in benefits benchmarking, plan design, annual renewals, and open enrollment management.

  • Demonstrated experience selecting, negotiating with, and managing benefits brokers, vendors, and insurance carriers.

  • Hands-on experience implementing and managing benefits technology, particularly Rippling HRIS.

  • In-depth knowledge of US and Canadian benefits programs, complemented by meaningful experience managing international benefits, particularly in the UK, France, and Germany.

  • Strong understanding of North American benefits compliance, including ACA, HIPAA, COBRA, ERISA, and nondiscrimination testing.

  • Experience administering and maintaining retirement plans, including 401(k), Group Registered Retirement Savings Plans (GRSP), and UK Auto-Enrolment.

  • Experience managing benefits across both directly operated legal entities and Employer of Record providers.

  • Proven ability to establish and manage benefits programs during organizational transitions, including new market launches, entity conversions, and mergers and acquisitions.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and coordinate cross-functional projects.

  • Excellent analytical skills and confidence working with benefits data, budgets, forecasts, and reporting.

  • A technology-oriented mindset, with an interest in using systems and automation to improve operational efficiency.

  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and navigate ambiguity in a lean, rapidly evolving environment.

  • Strong communication and organizational skills, with a practical and employee-focused approach to problem-solving.

Senior Machine Learning Engineer, FeedForward 3D/4D Reconstruction

• Advance feed-forward 3D and 4D reconstruction models, improving the prediction of scene geometry, camera poses, and visual appearance from real-world image and video captures using transformer-based architectures.

  • Extend existing reconstruction capabilities from static 3D environments to dynamic 4D scenes, incorporating temporal information, motion understanding, and consistency across video sequences.

  • Design, train, and optimize large-scale machine learning models using multi-node and multi-GPU infrastructure, working with extensive multi-view image and video datasets.

  • Define and implement reliable evaluation frameworks to measure reconstruction quality, geometric accuracy, temporal consistency, and overall model performance.

  • Investigate and integrate advanced generative approaches, including pre-trained video diffusion and flow-matching models, to improve reconstruction quality and address missing or incomplete visual information.

  • Design and conduct research experiments, analyze results, evaluate alternative architectures, and identify opportunities to improve model performance and scalability.

  • Collaborate with production and pipeline engineering teams to integrate research developments into operational systems, ensuring that models perform reliably in real-world customer applications.

  • Monitor the latest developments in computer vision, 3D reconstruction, generative AI, and machine learning research, identifying promising techniques and helping shape the team's technical roadmap.

  • Contribute to technical discussions and communicate research findings, model limitations, and recommendations clearly to researchers, engineers, and leadership.

  • Help optimize large-scale models for performance and efficiency, contributing to reusable tools, libraries, and potentially open-source initiatives.

    • Requirements:

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience developing and training feed-forward 3D reconstruction models, with familiarity with architectures and research approaches such as DUSt3R, VGGT, π³, or D4RT.

  • Strong expertise in computer vision, deep learning, 3D reconstruction, and machine learning, with a proven ability to develop models that deliver reliable results in practical applications.

  • Experience with large-scale distributed training, including multi-node and multi-GPU environments, and the ability to diagnose training bottlenecks, evaluate experiments, and optimize model performance.

  • Advanced proficiency in PyTorch and experience working within large, collaborative codebases involving production-quality development, build systems, and continuous integration workflows.

  • Strong research and analytical capabilities, with the ability to translate open-ended technical challenges into structured experiments, interpret results critically, and adapt approaches based on evidence.

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical concepts and research findings effectively to multidisciplinary teams and senior stakeholders.

  • A strong academic or professional track record in machine learning research and engineering. Relevant PhD research or equivalent practical research engineering experience is valued, with demonstrated technical depth taking priority over years of experience.

  • Experience predicting 3D Gaussian representations directly from images through feed-forward approaches, rather than relying on scene-specific optimization, is a significant advantage.

  • Publications or substantial research contributions in feed-forward reconstruction at leading conferences such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, or SIGGRAPH are highly desirable.

  • Familiarity with video diffusion models, flow-matching architectures, and camera-conditioned video generation is an additional advantage.

  • Experience with dynamic scene reconstruction, scene flow estimation, motion modelling, or temporal consistency is highly valued.

  • Exposure to real-world automotive, robotics, or drone datasets, including challenges such as imperfect camera calibration, motion blur, and inaccurate camera poses, is beneficial.

  • Experience optimizing large-scale machine learning models or contributing to widely used open-source reconstruction libraries is a plus.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, independence, and the ability to take ownership of complex research and engineering challenges.

  • Extend existing reconstruction capabilities from static 3D environments to dynamic 4D scenes, incorporating temporal information, motion understanding, and consistency across video sequences.

  • Design, train, and optimize large-scale machine learning models using multi-node and multi-GPU infrastructure, working with extensive multi-view image and video datasets.

  • Define and implement reliable evaluation frameworks to measure reconstruction quality, geometric accuracy, temporal consistency, and overall model performance.

  • Investigate and integrate advanced generative approaches, including pre-trained video diffusion and flow-matching models, to improve reconstruction quality and address missing or incomplete visual information.

  • Design and conduct research experiments, analyze results, evaluate alternative architectures, and identify opportunities to improve model performance and scalability.

  • Collaborate with production and pipeline engineering teams to integrate research developments into operational systems, ensuring that models perform reliably in real-world customer applications.

  • Monitor the latest developments in computer vision, 3D reconstruction, generative AI, and machine learning research, identifying promising techniques and helping shape the team's technical roadmap.

  • Contribute to technical discussions and communicate research findings, model limitations, and recommendations clearly to researchers, engineers, and leadership.

  • Help optimize large-scale models for performance and efficiency, contributing to reusable tools, libraries, and potentially open-source initiatives.

    • Requirements:

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience developing and training feed-forward 3D reconstruction models, with familiarity with architectures and research approaches such as DUSt3R, VGGT, π³, or D4RT.

  • Strong expertise in computer vision, deep learning, 3D reconstruction, and machine learning, with a proven ability to develop models that deliver reliable results in practical applications.

  • Experience with large-scale distributed training, including multi-node and multi-GPU environments, and the ability to diagnose training bottlenecks, evaluate experiments, and optimize model performance.

  • Advanced proficiency in PyTorch and experience working within large, collaborative codebases involving production-quality development, build systems, and continuous integration workflows.

  • Strong research and analytical capabilities, with the ability to translate open-ended technical challenges into structured experiments, interpret results critically, and adapt approaches based on evidence.

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical concepts and research findings effectively to multidisciplinary teams and senior stakeholders.

  • A strong academic or professional track record in machine learning research and engineering. Relevant PhD research or equivalent practical research engineering experience is valued, with demonstrated technical depth taking priority over years of experience.

  • Experience predicting 3D Gaussian representations directly from images through feed-forward approaches, rather than relying on scene-specific optimization, is a significant advantage.

  • Publications or substantial research contributions in feed-forward reconstruction at leading conferences such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, or SIGGRAPH are highly desirable.

  • Familiarity with video diffusion models, flow-matching architectures, and camera-conditioned video generation is an additional advantage.

  • Experience with dynamic scene reconstruction, scene flow estimation, motion modelling, or temporal consistency is highly valued.

  • Exposure to real-world automotive, robotics, or drone datasets, including challenges such as imperfect camera calibration, motion blur, and inaccurate camera poses, is beneficial.

  • Experience optimizing large-scale machine learning models or contributing to widely used open-source reconstruction libraries is a plus.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, independence, and the ability to take ownership of complex research and engineering challenges.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive annual salary ranging from €120,000 to €170,000, with compensation discussed transparently early in the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working opportunities across Europe.

  • Flexible working arrangements aligned with Central European working hours, with regular collaboration and overlap with North American teams.

  • Employer-paid supplemental healthcare coverage, including medical, dental, vision, and mental health benefits.

  • Flexible paid vacation and sick leave.

  • Winter company shutdown and more than 11 public holidays per year.

  • Paid parental leave.

  • Dedicated equipment budget to optimize your remote working environment.

  • Annual learning and professional development stipend.

  • Opportunity to work on advanced machine learning research and technologies with real-world applications in autonomous systems and physical AI.

  • Collaborative and inclusive international working environment that encourages creativity, technical excellence, and knowledge sharing.

  • Significant technical ownership and the opportunity to influence the development and scaling of next-generation 3D/4D reconstruction technologies.

Senior Research Scientist 3D Reconstruction & Spatial AI

• Design, develop, and deploy real-time spatial perception and state estimation pipelines using advanced in-house AI models and open-source architectures.
  • Build and optimize multi-sensor fusion systems integrating RGB-D cameras, stereo vision, and IMU data into dense 3D spatial representations, including point clouds, neural occupancy grids, and implicit signed distance function fields.
  • Develop geometric and semantic perception systems that transform unstructured 3D environments into structured, queryable world models.
  • Build object-centric 3D scene graphs that capture object identities, spatial relationships, and functional properties to support intelligent robotic decision-making.
  • Integrate open-vocabulary vision-language models, including CLIP-based visual descriptors and DINOv2, into 3D metric spaces to enable robots to interpret and execute natural language instructions.
  • Develop learning-based spatial models, including 3D diffusion policies, that leverage point clouds to predict continuous grasping poses and manipulation trajectories.
  • Translate high-level semantic understanding into functional robotic affordances, identifying actionable object properties such as graspable areas, containment regions, and interaction points.
  • Connect semantic reasoning systems with low-level robotic manipulation and grasping policies, ensuring reliable execution of complex tasks.
  • Collaborate with robotics and engineering teams to ensure that probabilistic, learning-based perception models integrate safely with deterministic control systems and physical hardware constraints.
  • Lead data strategies for collecting, labeling, generating, and curating real-world and synthetic 3D datasets.
  • Drive research and experimentation in spatial intelligence, 3D reconstruction, multimodal learning, and embodied AI.
  • Optimize perception and reconstruction systems for real-time performance, robustness, accuracy, and scalability in dynamic industrial environments.

    • Requirements:

  • PhD (preferred) or Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, or another quantitative discipline, with a specialization in Spatial AI, SLAM, Embodied AI, or a related field.
  • Strong theoretical and mathematical foundations in 3D computer vision, including multi-view geometry, camera calibration, visual-inertial odometry (VIO), and probabilistic state estimation.
  • Demonstrated experience developing, training, and deploying advanced multimodal deep learning architectures, including Vision-Language Models (VLMs), Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs), and contrastive learning frameworks.
  • Experience with 3D neural scene representations and reconstruction techniques, such as Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) and 3D Gaussian Splatting.
  • Expert-level programming skills in Python and strong practical experience with PyTorch.
  • Strong understanding of geometric and semantic perception, 3D scene understanding, spatial representations, and sensor fusion techniques.
  • Experience translating research concepts and advanced machine learning models into practical, production-ready systems.
  • Ability to design and implement robust spatial AI pipelines capable of operating in real-time and dynamic environments.
  • Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving abilities, with a track record of independently tackling complex technical challenges.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across research, software engineering, and robotics teams.

  • Experience with robotics middleware and frameworks, particularly ROS2.

Senior Software Engineer, Bot Detection (Client-Side & Signals)

• Design, develop, and deploy production-ready bot detection signals across multiple platform surfaces, including browser applications, APIs, Git/LFS, command-line tools, and client libraries.

  • Build and maintain browser and device fingerprinting capabilities, client-side challenges, TLS/HTTP fingerprinting mechanisms, and behavioral telemetry systems.

  • Investigate real-world bot technologies and automation techniques, including headless browsers, anti-detect browsers, residential proxies, and CAPTCHA-solving services.

  • Develop and continuously improve countermeasures against sophisticated automated abuse, adapting detection strategies as malicious actors evolve their techniques.

  • Analyze browser behavior, network characteristics, and client interactions to identify patterns that distinguish human users from automated systems.

  • Collaborate with data-focused detection engineers to transform raw telemetry and collected signals into reliable detection features and actionable decisions.

  • Work closely with infrastructure, security, and platform engineering teams to implement mitigation strategies, including rate limiting, additional verification challenges, and enforcement mechanisms.

  • Ensure detection systems operate reliably and efficiently at scale while minimizing friction for legitimate developers, researchers, and API users.

  • Apply privacy-conscious engineering principles when collecting and processing behavioral and technical signals.

  • Contribute to open-source tooling, technical documentation, research, and knowledge-sharing initiatives whenever appropriate.

    • Requirements

  • Proven hands-on experience in bot detection, anti-fraud engineering, browser fingerprinting, web security, or a closely related technical discipline.

  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and maintaining production-grade detection systems.

  • Deep understanding of browser internals and web technologies, including JavaScript, the DOM, rendering APIs, WebGL, Canvas, Audio APIs, and browser extensions.

  • Strong knowledge of networking protocols and technologies, particularly HTTP/2, HTTP/3, and TLS.

  • Practical understanding of browser automation tools and techniques, including Puppeteer, Playwright, Selenium, stealth plugins, and other automation frameworks.

  • Strong programming skills in TypeScript and JavaScript, alongside proficiency in at least one backend language such as Python, Go, or Rust.

  • Ability to investigate sophisticated automation techniques, understand how they operate, and translate findings into effective detection and prevention strategies.

  • Experience building pragmatic technical solutions, prioritizing production impact, continuous improvement, and adaptability over unnecessary complexity.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of complex technical challenges.

  • A strong commitment to user privacy and the ability to balance effective abuse prevention with a smooth experience for legitimate users.

    • Nice-to-have qualifications:

  • Published research, technical articles, or conference presentations related to browser fingerprinting, bot detection, or web measurement.

  • Academic or industry research experience combined with an interest in deploying practical solutions in production environments.

  • Previous experience working for a bot-management, anti-fraud, CDN, or Web Application Firewall (WAF) provider.

  • Contributions to open-source projects, particularly in web security, browser technologies, automation, or network measurement.

As Senior Tax Administrator I, you will oversee day-to-day tax operations, improve reporting and automation processes, and ensure critical workflows are consistently delivered. You will also provide operational coverage across tax-related activities and coordinate with internal teams to resolve issues efficiently. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Tax Operations and Process Management

  • Document core workflows and system procedures to ensure processes are repeatable, transparent, and accessible to the entire team.

  • Manage incoming mail and tax notice routing, including duplicate state notices, while meeting established turnaround standards.

  • Own operational handoffs with the State Unemployment Insurance (SUI) program manager to reduce claims at their source.

  • Send correction letters to state agencies when employees file unemployment claims under a production company instead of the employer of record.

  • Maintain the LLC-to-EOR correction agent in collaboration with the People team and manage employee guidance on how to file claims correctly.

  • Handle employment and income verification requests (VOE).

  • Reporting, Analytics, and Automation

  • Own Tax Operations reporting from development through automation, validation, and ongoing maintenance.

  • Reconcile reports against source data before sharing them with leadership, investigating discrepancies and addressing root causes.

  • Manage reporting activities such as unemployment insurance claims status, monthly KPI reporting, New Jersey SB 422 compliance reporting, Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reporting, and film state tax incentive reporting.

  • Collaborate with analytics, AI Operations, and product teams to improve reporting automation.

  • Own the claims KPI dashboard and communicate performance trends, key drivers, and opportunities for improvement.

  • AI Agent and Workflow Ownership

  • Manage the team's AI agents throughout their lifecycle, from development and testing to maintenance and retirement.

  • Validate changes before deployment, troubleshoot issues, and document how each agent operates.

  • Maintain an inventory of agents, including their purpose, owner, and last testing date.

  • Measure the time saved and operational volume handled by automated workflows, retiring tools that no longer provide value.

  • Determine which processes should be automated and where human review remains necessary.

  • Verify agent outputs against source data before they are used in operational or reporting workflows.

  • Coordinate the rollout of new agents and processes through team training, documentation, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

  • Work with AI Operations on more advanced automation initiatives.

  • Tax Compliance and Operational Support

  • Provide backup support for multi-state SUTA corrections, audits, payroll tax filings, payments, and agency notices when team members are unavailable or workloads increase.

  • Support tax incentive activities by preparing filings, reconciliations, and audit-ready reports.

  • Serve as backup for the Tax Incentives Analyst when needed.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Manage operational handoffs with the People team, Payroll Operations, Support, Customer Success, AI Operations, and Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) teams.

  • Resolve cross-functional issues directly, communicate priorities, and escalate blockers early with clear recommendations.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines strong payroll tax operations experience with practical reporting, process improvement, and AI automation skills. You should be comfortable owning operational workflows independently, working with complex tax data, and introducing improvements that can be measured and adopted by others.

  • At least 4 years of experience in payroll tax or tax operations, ideally within an employer-of-record (EOR), professional employer organization (PEO), or payroll service provider environment.

  • Hands-on experience managing state agency notices.

  • Experience building reports or dashboards using payroll or tax data and reconciling results against source systems.

  • Practical experience building and maintaining AI agents or automated workflows used by a team, including validating outputs before deployment and measuring their operational impact.

  • Proven ability to manage a case queue or operational workstream and improve performance through process changes and clear SOPs.

  • Review, validate, and process vendor invoices, ensuring accurate general ledger coding, cost center allocation, supporting documentation, and compliance with internal policies.

  • Prepare and maintain general ledger and balance sheet account reconciliations, ensuring accuracy and timely resolution of discrepancies.

  • Maintain organized supporting schedules and documentation for financial reporting and audit requirements.

  • Manage Brex credit card user access, including onboarding new users, deactivating inactive accounts, and maintaining appropriate permissions.
  • Review and clear bank transactions by matching deposits, disbursements, and other activities with the corresponding invoices, payments, and accounting entries.
  • Perform assigned bank and cash account reconciliations, investigate unmatched transactions, and resolve outstanding reconciling items.
  • Monitor bank clearing accounts and coordinate with Accounts Payable and other accounting colleagues to resolve exceptions.
  • Month-End Closing and Financial Reporting
  • Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities, ensuring accurate and timely reporting.
  • Perform accounts payable aging reviews, account balance analyses, and variance investigations.
  • Review invoices received after the accounts payable closing period to identify unrecorded expenses relating to previous accounting periods.
  • Prepare monthly accrual reports for review by the Senior Accountant and subsequent journal entry posting.
  • Identify unusual transactions, discrepancies, and accounting issues, recommending appropriate corrective actions.
  • Coordinate with the accounting team to ensure all assigned closing activities are completed within established deadlines.

  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting workflows, reduce manual activities, and strengthen internal controls.
  • Leverage technology, AI-powered tools, and automation solutions to optimize invoice processing, reconciliations, reporting, and recurring accounting activities.
  • Support the implementation, testing, and optimization of accounting systems and workflow improvements.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, process documentation, and tracking tools.
  • Collaborate with Finance, Procurement, and other departments to ensure accurate and timely financial transactions.
  • Support internal and external audits by preparing reconciliations, schedules, and requested documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with US GAAP, internal accounting policies, and established financial controls.

You will define and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for a core area within a global fintech ecosystem. Working across multiple teams and product surfaces, you will translate complex user needs, financial workflows, and technical constraints into scalable solutions while maintaining high standards of product quality and execution.

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for a key Fintech domain, ensuring alignment with broader business objectives and user needs.

  • Lead cross-functional product initiatives from discovery and definition through delivery, collaborating with Engineering, Design, and relevant business stakeholders.

  • Develop and improve financial experiences across cards, payouts, withdrawals, liquidity and advance products, and money movement workflows.

  • Enhance the reliability, performance, usability, and scalability of financial products serving contractors and employees worldwide.

  • Drive alignment and clarity across multiple product surfaces, teams, and stakeholders to ensure consistent execution.

  • Investigate user problems in depth, analyzing financial logic, system behavior, technical dependencies, and operational constraints.

  • Translate complex requirements into clear product specifications, priorities, and actionable guidance for engineering teams.

  • Take a hands-on approach to resolving product challenges, clarifying edge cases, investigating issues, and unblocking delivery.

  • Collaborate closely with Compliance, Treasury, and Operations to ensure products meet regulatory, financial, and operational requirements.

  • Establish and maintain high standards for product quality, documentation, communication, and decision-making.

  • Use data, customer insights, and product performance indicators to guide prioritization and continuously improve outcomes.

    • Requirements:

    You are a senior product leader with substantial experience building consumer fintech products and managing complex product domains. You combine strong product judgment with systems thinking and analytical decision-making, and you are comfortable operating independently in a fast-moving environment. You can move between strategic planning and detailed execution, communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders, and navigate the complexities of regulated financial products.

  • Approximately 7+ years of Product Management experience, with a strong track record of delivering impactful products.

  • Significant experience in consumer fintech, particularly in areas such as Earned Wage Access (EWA), payment cards, or comparable consumer financial products.

  • Proven ability to own complex, high-impact product areas with limited oversight.

  • Strong product sense and systems-thinking capabilities, with the ability to understand interconnected workflows and technical dependencies.

  • Data-driven decision-making skills and experience using insights and performance metrics to guide product strategy.

  • Experience working closely with Engineering, Compliance, and Operations teams in a regulated financial environment.

  • Strong understanding of financial products, money movement processes, and the operational considerations involved in delivering reliable financial experiences.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clarity and alignment across diverse stakeholders.

  • A hands-on and proactive approach to product leadership, including requirements definition, issue investigation, debugging, and resolving complex edge cases.

  • Ability to balance strategic ownership with detailed execution in a fast-paced, global environment.

Lead the global People strategy and operations, partnering with executive leadership to support business growth, organizational transformation, and an engaging employee experience across international markets.

Lambda is hiring a Staff Cash Accountant to run our daily cash cycle and, just as importantly, to automate it. You will report to the Assistant Controller and work closely with the AP/AR team, Treasury, and Finance Systems.

 

Cash is the balance every stakeholder checks first, and our transaction volume continues to grow as Lambda scales and builds the financial infrastructure needed for its next chapter. We do not want to keep pace by adding people to match transactions by hand. Instead, we want someone who sees repeated manual steps as opportunities to automate and improve how we work. This is an entry-level role with real ownership, an opportunity to shape how the work gets done, and a direct line to technical and operational accounting leadership.

 

What You'll Do

Automate the cash cycle

 - Map the current cash process end to end, measure where the hours go, and keep a prioritized backlog of automation opportunities with the time each one saves

 - Build and maintain bank-feed import and auto-matching rules in NetSuite so routine transactions post and clear without manual entry

 - Configure reconciliation automation in Numeric (AutoRec) and own the exception queue, so review time goes to true breaks rather than matched items

 - Partner with Finance Systems and Treasury on bank connectivity, payment-processor integrations, and the control each automated step needs

Run the daily cash cycle

 - Reconcile all bank, credit card, and payment-processor accounts to the general ledger daily, and clear reconciling items within the week

 - Record cash receipts, disbursements, bank fees, interest, and intercompany transfers in NetSuite, with support attached to every entry

 - Monitor bank portals for incoming wires and ACH, and flag unexpected or unidentified activity to the Assistant Controller the same day

 - Maintain the daily cash position report so Treasury and FP&A work from one number

Customer payment application

 - Apply customer payments received by wire, ACH, check, and card to the correct invoices in the AR subledger

 - Research and resolve unapplied and unidentified cash, short-pays, and over-pays with the AP/AR team and Sales Operations

 - Keep unapplied cash aged under 30 days, and feed every exception back into better matching rules

Month-end close and controls

 - Prepare month-end bank and cash-related reconciliations in Numeric, with tie-outs to bank statements and the subledger, on the close calendar

 - Prepare the cash and cash-equivalents flux commentary and support the cash flow statement tie-out

 - Execute and document cash controls under our SOX program, and make sure every automated step has a control, an owner, and evidence that satisfies internal audit and EY

 - Support quarterly reviews and the year-end audit with cash confirmations, reconciliations, and sample support
